                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (the fiscal
                year starting on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an
                existing member id it is de-duplicated with a trailing '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>', where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and YY is the last
                two digits of the calendar year in which that fiscal year begins (so a
                registration date of 2026-10-02 yields 'FY26' and 2026-03-02 yields 'FY25').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with runs of
                whitespace collapsed). Owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true
                for an address already used by a same-last-name owner receive the same
                value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, starting at 0: plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure spans at
                least one elapsed fiscal year (the registration date's fiscal year precedes the
                current fiscal year, the fiscal year starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and
                level 4 for 6 or more points. A new owner's level is then capped so it cannot
                exceed one above the current maximum membership level among their household
                members at creation time; with no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The pet owner's locality: the REGION segment of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                member id, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the city-to-region table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD,
                else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The pet owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The pet owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when
                the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true

              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (by registration
                date), signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Evaluated against the
                current daily total each time the owner is read.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (case-insensitively), signalling that it is approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; otherwise false. Evaluated against the current city total each time
                the owner is read. The hard rejection at 50 owners is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The pet owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age in whole
                years at the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 digest over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the normalized E.164 telephone or
                an empty string, the lower-cased email or an empty string, and the Soundex code of the
                last name, joined by '|'). This single key is the sole criterion for duplicate
                detection: a create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the new owner's whole
                identity key equals an existing, non-deleted owner's. Because the telephone is part of
                the key, two owners with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                distinct identity keys and are both allowed (created as a soft match).
              type: string

              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate (its identity key differs from
                every existing owner's), shares an existing owner's last-name Soundex code and
                postcode, flagging it as a possible duplicate of that owner; otherwise false.
                Determined once, against the existing owners, when the owner is created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (a
                different identity key but the same last-name Soundex code and postcode) when it was
                created. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                deleting the owner via DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining
                the record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'. When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (typically the street
            number and name). Optional for backward compatibility: an owner may instead supply
            the flat 'address'. When a non-blank 'addressLine1' is supplied the structured
            fields are preferred over the flat 'address'. It is normalized before being stored
            and returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of whitespace
            collapsed to a single space, the value is upper-cased and common abbreviations are
            expanded as whole tokens (ST -> STREET, RD -> ROAD, AVE -> AVENUE). So '10 king st'
            is stored and returned as '10 KING STREET'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (for example
            a unit or apartment). Normalized with the same rules as 'addressLine1'. When present
            it is appended to the composed 'address' after the normalized 'addressLine1',
            separated by a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'UNIT 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input and kept for backward
            compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured 'addressLine1' (plus the
            optional 'addressLine2'), which are preferred when a non-blank 'addressLine1' is
            present. An owner must supply an address in EITHER form. When supplied as flat input
            it is normalized before being stored and returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed
            and internal runs of whitespace collapsed to a single space, the value is upper-cased
            and common abbreviations are expanded as whole tokens (ST -> STREET, RD -> ROAD,
            AVE -> AVENUE). So '  12  main  st ' is stored and returned as '12 MAIN STREET'. On
            output this is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present, otherwise the
            normalized flat address. A flat address that is blank after normalization is rejected
            with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The pet owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region per the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), where the region is derived from
            the city (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD). A postcode out of
            range for the city's region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized into E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces,
            dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'. The pattern
            tolerates an optional leading '+' plus digits and separators (spaces, brackets,
            dashes); numbers that cannot form valid E.164 are rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it must be a
            syntactically valid email address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it
            is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand', computed as the owner's age in whole years
            at the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the
            same last name and address (compared case-insensitively, with runs of whitespace
            collapsed). When omitted or false, such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this pet owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by
                a single space (e.g. 'DR Who') when a title is present, or just the last name
                when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code (with its
                leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped in threes and
                space-separated. For example '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'.
                The raw 'telephone' field keeps its canonical E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The pet owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (the fiscal
                year starting on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an
                existing member id it is de-duplicated with a trailing '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>', where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and YY is the last
                two digits of the calendar year in which that fiscal year begins (so a
                registration date of 2026-10-02 yields 'FY26' and 2026-03-02 yields 'FY25').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with runs of
                whitespace collapsed). Owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true
                for an address already used by a same-last-name owner receive the same
                value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A1B2'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, starting at 0: plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure spans at
                least one elapsed fiscal year (the registration date's fiscal year precedes the
                current fiscal year, the fiscal year starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and
                level 4 for 6 or more points. A new owner's level is then capped so it cannot
                exceed one above the current maximum membership level among their household
                members at creation time; with no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The pet owner's locality: the REGION segment of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                member id, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the city-to-region table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD,
                else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'

## Summary

I implemented the read-only `riskFlag` field on the owner API response. It returns `true` when **any** of the three conditions hold, otherwise `false`.

**Changes made:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added the `riskFlag` read-only boolean property to the `Owner` schema (the DTOs are generated from this spec at build time), with a description documenting the three triggering conditions.

2. **`DisposableEmailValidator.java`** — Added `isDisposableAdjacent(email)`. A domain is "disposable-adjacent" when it is *not* itself on the hard blocklist (those are rejected at create and never stored), yet is closely related to a disposable domain: a **subdomain** of a blocked domain (e.g. `smtp.mailinator.com`) or a **sibling** sharing a blocked second-level label under a different TLD (e.g. `mailinator.net`). Reuses the existing blocklist.

3. **`ClinicService` / `ClinicServiceImpl`** — Added `isCityOverSoftCapacity(city)`, defined as `count >= 40` owners (case-insensitively), reusing the existing `CITY_CAPACITY_WARNING_THRESHOLD` — the per-city *soft* limit below the hard capacity of 50.

4. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Marked `riskFlag` as `ignore` in `toOwnerDto` (consistent with `capacityWarning`/`bulkSignupWarning`, which are set in the controller since they depend on live service counts).

5. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — `toOwnerDtoWithWarning` now sets `riskFlag` via a new `isRiskFlag` helper combining `owner.getPossibleDuplicate()`, the disposable-adjacent email check, and the soft-capacity check — so every owner response (GET, create, idempotent replay) carries it.

**Definitional choices:** the spec's three terms map to existing codebase concepts — "possible duplicate" is the persisted `possibleDuplicate` flag; "over its soft capacity" reuses the existing 40-owner soft threshold (vs. the 50 hard cap); "disposable-adjacent" is a new, narrowly-scoped notion built on the existing disposable-domain blocklist. These are documented in the OpenAPI description and Javadoc.

Build is `BUILD SUCCESS`; the new `coreRiskFlagFalseNormally` test and the full suite pass (a fresh unique owner has no email, a single-owner city, and no duplicate — so all three conditions are false).
